title: Comparative Vocabulary of the Naga Tribes of Manipur (Tangkhul Section)
title_translation: Comparative Vocabulary of the Naga Tribes of Manipur
creator: T. C. Hodson
notes: Comparative linguistic appendix from The Naga Tribes of Manipur covering numerals, anatomy, flora, fauna, and cultural institutions across Manipur hill tribes. Public domain.
alternate_title: Comparative Vocabulary of the Naga Tribes of Manipur
background: Published in 1911 by Macmillan and Co. in London as the linguistic and lexicographical appendix to T. C. Hodson's seminal ethnography 'The Naga Tribes of Manipur'. Systematically compares vocabularies of Tangkhul, Mao, Maram, Kabui, and Maring across standardized semantic lists: numerals, anatomical terms, fauna, agriculture, religion, kin relations, and traditional technology.
phonology_notes: Harmonizes phonetic transcriptions across multiple hill languages, providing an invaluable early 20th-century comparative baseline for assessing phonetic correspondence and loanwords.

entries.example: Machi kongwui machi (Boiled salt cakes from the natural brine springs).
